title: Trump official calls out 'lethal' attitude from budget bill critics #shorts
transcript: So, I did spend two years of my life where my primary job was to explain the federal budget to the American people, which is why I've been so disheartened to see some on the right, I'm not going to get into names here, Larry, but some on the right who have been deliberately misrepresenting the bill because they're afraid of winning. They're afraid of success. In other words, there there's this attitude amongst some conservatives where they don't ever want to get to yes. They don't ever want to pass a bill. That kind of attitude is lethal to enacting a winning conservative populist agenda to set our agenda for the country to enact the reforms that we campaigned on.
